title: Basement unit added to a three-flat

project.description: Conversion of the basement of an existing three-flat to a new fourth dwelling unit. Zoning district RT-4. Standard Plan Review.
project.reviewer: Department of Buildings, first review cycle

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: The ceiling height in the basement bedroom is not shown. Dimension it on the section.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: A second exit from the basement unit is not indicated on the plan.

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: The added unit increases density. Show the lot area per unit calculation in the zoning data.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The fire-resistance rating of the floor assembly between the basement unit and the first floor is not shown. Indicate it on the section and provide the assembly detail.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: Provide the asbestos survey from the owner's environmental consultant.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The drawing date on the title sheet differs from the date on the rest of the set. Correct it.

expected.why: Interior space dimensions need a field-verified dimension from the architect.
Exit count and layout is a life-safety design decision.
The density calculation is the architect's under the residential district rules. Don't compute it.
Assembly rating is fire-resistance design, despite the General heading, and both named sheets change.
It comes from the owner's consultant, so ask the owner.
